ctx.x: Did you all have a kids band?

items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Oh, Jack Lane? Yeah. Well, you mean orchestra, huh? No, I mean band work... he played a good rhythmic, uh, bass drum

ctx.x: with, uh, possibly two grown-ups, the old man Lane, Jack. Uh, I remember when, when I had a fight with Pansy on the Canal Street Fern. You see, he cut this, see that cut? Yeah, you told me about that. How'd that happen? Well, he, he was looking for trouble, and I tried to give it to him. Before I could put it on his jaw, he ripped me with a knife. I didn't know he had a knife. Well, you're damn lucky you didn't cut your tendons, man. Well, I was lucky, because I had this hand straight up. Of course, in those…
Jack style. I never let him play, uh, uh, drum. Do you remember it at all? Oh, Jack Lane? Yeah. Well, you mean orchestra, huh? No, I mean band work, either for dance or for, uh, marching.

Marching? Marching, yeah. Well, uh, he, he's, uh, he played, uh, steady, uh, nothing, uh, sensational. Didn't drag? No, nothing sensational. No. He, he played a good rhythmic, uh, bass drum and a, uh,
